aa.purpose: Small stochastic/evaluator sanity control. Both independently isolated shoppers receive the same private needs and visible baseline experience. No claim of a precise false-positive rate.

repeats.order: Reverse each case's original within-pair order.
repeats.purpose: Descriptive repeatability check; repeats are not independent fresh scenarios.

reporting: Retain every preselected control assignment, failures and missing outcomes. Keep controls separate from the fixed 60-pair main cohort; never replace a main-cohort result or pool repeated cases as independent observations.
